m0-context.title: Load baseline context
m0-context.imperative: Read docs/agents/CREW_CONTEXT.md, docs/agents/GLOSSARY.md, the g6-implement-handoff.md, and the G4 VERDICT.md. Verify the handoff is complete (task, intent, scope, exclusions, required evidence, test mode, stop conditions); if incomplete, block and return. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: crew context + glossary + handoff + G4 VERDICT loaded; handoff complete

m1-run-old.title: Re-run C1 dashboard on OLD store (fixed sim)
m1-run-old.imperative: Run the dashboard fresh on the OLD store with the G5-fixed sim live: py scripts/driver_utilization_dashboard.py --cases 'Monaco:VER,Italy:VER,Great Britain:VER,Singapore:VER' --mc-samples 50 --seed 42 --db data/physics_estimates.db. Capture the real ASCII table + the per-regime U for all 4 RBR cases. 4/4 ok or honest per-case errors.

postconditions.statement: OLD-store dashboard re-ran on the fixed sim; CSV reports/physics/driver_util_subset_2023.csv regenerated; per-regime U captured (real numbers)

check.command: py -c "import pandas as pd; d=pd.read_csv('reports/physics/driver_util_subset_2023.csv'); rbr=d[d.constructor=='Red Bull Racing']; assert len(rbr)==4; assert set(rbr.gp_name)=={'Monaco','Italy','Great Britain','Singapore'}; assert (rbr.split_is_impure==True).all(); print('OLD CSV fresh: 4 RBR rows', sorted(rbr.gp_name))"

constraints: do NOT re-fix sim / change car_prior / fits / store / thresholds

m3-tests.title: Verify physics + utilization unit tests green
m3-tests.imperative: Run the required test surface and confirm green: py -m pytest tests/unit/physics/ tests/unit/test_utilization.py -q. No production code is expected to change; this confirms the fixed sim + utilization path are intact.

m4-verdict.title: Build comparison table + write updated VERDICT.md
m4-verdict.imperative: Build the PRE-FIX(G4) -> POST-FIX-OLD -> POST-FIX-WIRED per-regime per-case table from the fresh numbers + the preserved G4 numbers. Answer (a) did u_braking/u_fast un-clip from 2.0? (b) are regimes physical (<=1) / separating? (c) does WIRED ceiling differ from OLD on the fixed sim? Overwrite VERDICT.md with per-regime GO/CONTEXTUAL/NO-GO on the fixed sim, deciding numbers, G4 pre-fix preserved as reference, honest caveats. Honest, not forced.

postconditions.statement: VERDICT.md updated with per-regime verdict + pre-fix->post-fix->OLD-vs-WIRED table + explicit un-clip statement + G4 reference preserved

payload.verdict: braking/fast NO-GO (still clipped 2.0), straight/slow CONTEXTUAL trending NO-GO
